lines: Hunter's Mark Support now fits minion skills (Summon Skeletons, Raise Zombie and the rest), as the game allows: half of the minion blows lay a Mark, and with 10 Marks the enemy takes 17% more damage from you and all your minions (in-game Guardian debuff). Before, the page called it "needs Bow" and counted it as an empty socket.
Energy Shield now counts "N% of your Evasion is added as Energy Shield" (Spirit-Silk Kimono): that share of your total Evasion, added after your Energy Shield increases, as the game's tooltip shows.
Item lines with a negative value now use the game's own wording, e.g. "Energy Shield Recharge starts 20% sooner" instead of "starts -20% later".
Database: uniques that never drop at random and have no known source now say "Might not be obtainable" (was "Does not drop").

Two-handed Oathwords (Bladesong): the weapon's own power lines (its physical damage) now count once, as the game does since patch 88; the +skill level line still counts twice. Bladesong bows and swords show and deal less (thanks to the player who reported it).
Fixed: loading some Mage saves with a Conduit-linked spell failed with "Maximum call stack size exceeded".

Database: Gnome-made, Core Touched and Ashen bases can be found by typing their kind in the search box ("gnome" finds the 6 Gnome-made rings, amulets and belt), and a new Base kind filter (Plain, Core Touched, Ashen, Gnome-made) sits on Uniques, Item bases and All.

EHP: block lines that need a shield or two weapons (Oath of the Aegis, Oath of the Bulwark, Shield Bash, Shield Wall, Twin Discipline) now count when you hold one, and "% of Physical Damage taken as Fire, Cold and Lightning" notables (Tempered Hide and the like) now count: that part of a physical hit meets your Fire, Cold and Lightning resistances instead of armour. The max hit table follows it, and the tree heat map and gear searches now value these when weighing defence.

Arrow Totem, Spell Totem and Ballista: your own attack or cast speed no longer adds damage to them. When your speed was past a skill's cap, the planner turned the extra into damage even when a totem was using the skill, though a totem fires on its own clock. Builds like Hoarfrost Volley with Arrow Totem and high attack speed show less DPS now (about 12% on a player's build), and attack speed lines no longer show a gain for them.

Uniques now show their Red Tier (I to IV), as the game's Collection does: it goes by the level a unique drops from, and the Cube's red recipes use it. Tooltips, the Database, the Market and the Character tab's item window show it and can filter by it (it replaces the base tier shown in the last update).

Uniques now show the Tier the game puts on their card (Tier 1 = the best base of its kind) in their tooltips and cards, and you can filter by it in the Database, the Market and the Character tab's item window.

The old unique "Tier" filter (Standard, Signature, Core, Primal, Chase) is now called Kind, and the Market and the Character tab's item window have it too, with Chase, Primal and Core marks on Market listings.

Entropy (Chaos support and the Chaos keystones): implosions are about 25% bigger. The game lays Entropy from your hit before the general hero damage cut (x0.8), and crits lay crit-sized Entropy (both checked in the game log). Hallowed ground and Unravel no longer raise implosions: they count on hits only, and Entropy is not a hit.
Skill panel numbers with Entropy now match the game's tooltip, which counts the laid share at its implosion size.
Recent Patch: the TLDR now has an entry for patch 87, including the higher Vow rune costs.

Game hotfix of 23 Nov (still build 88): the game's own scaling of red lines changed, and the planner now follows it. Rimecrown Staff (its second line much lower, its first line x1.5), Cinderwick (primal) higher, and new scales on Heart of the White Silence and the primal Wintercall Orb, The Thousand Sparks, Orrery of the Long Night and Charnel Bell (from the game log).

Skill tooltips: the Conversion line now names the damage types a skill converts and shows with an example how its own conversion and conversion from supports and gear are scaled down together when they add up to more than 100%.

Storm Spark and Winter Orb cast by a Channel Conduit: their Sparks and icicles now strike on their own clock while you channel. Before, the planner counted only the conduit's casts, so these builds showed about 1% of their damage (checked against the game log on the Training Post).
Convergence is no longer counted for Sparks cast by a Channel Conduit: each conduit cast replaces the Sparks, so they never build it (game log, 22 Nov).

Patch 88: Chaos damage. The Chaos supports, the chaos keystones and the chaos reds now lay part of each hit as Entropy, which implodes as Chaos damage. It ignores Armour and elemental resistance and shows as its own "Entropy (Chaos)" row. Woe of Entropy raises it. First version, from the patch texts, not checked in a fight yet.

Patch 88 golems: Grave, Flame, Ice, Storm and Venom Golem are separate gems, each with its own blessing whatever its supports. The Grave Golem's blessing gives no damage now. The Storm Golem's shock and the Ice Golem's chill count for you and your minions.

Patch 88 late gem-level damage from the game's own table: Death Coil, Venom Spark, Ember Bolt, Winter Orb, Rime Spark, Fuse Arrow, Lightning Arrow, Pyre of Faith, Cyclone, Thousand Cuts, Flurry and others go up. Judgement (about 46% less at gem 20) and Storm Brand go down.
Tear now cashes at most 4 seconds of a Bleed (patch 88).

New red lines counted: Overclock Coil, The Long Battery, the item Oaths (counted at their full 10%), Arcanist's Overflow, The Bastion Psalm, The Third Thunder, Halo of the Restless Saint (counted standing still), The Falling Feather, Pyreheart Signet, "your crits always Poison / Ignite / Bleed", Bonebreaker Wraps, Lightsworn Reliquary and The Ossuary Lantern.

Brewery: the "of the ... Answer" potion lines now count at the share the game data gives them. Before patch 88 that was half, which explains our 16 Nov test; since patch 88 it is 10-33%, so these potions add much less damage.
Guardian life now runs to Rupture 180 from new game logs (Rupture 180 is a Gate).

FAQ: the damage-engine list comes from the game data (patch 88 kept one tree node per defence). Reds drop from monster level 35. The first Catacombs clear pays Gloomsilver. Recent Patch has a build 88 summary, and the new golems and reds have their icons.
